sections.title: 5. Surgical and Endovascular Management of Aortic Aneurysms
sections.details: Various methods and guidelines regarding the surgical and endovascular management of aortic aneurysms, including the use of stent grafts for aortic arch diseases.

sections.title: 6.5.1. Surgery for Surgical Replacement of the Ascending Aorta and Aortic Valve
sections.details: Guidelines for surgery involving replacement of the ascending aorta and the aortic valve, including valve-sparing procedures and repair techniques.

genes.context: FBN1 gene mutations are implicated in connective tissue disorders such as Marfan syndrome, affecting aortic root dilation.
Mutations in the ACTA2 gene can lead to familial thoracic aortic aneurysms and dissections, requiring monitoring of aortic dimensions.
TGFBR2 gene mutations are associated with Loeys-Dietz syndrome, often resulting in aggressive aortic aneurysms needing surgical intervention.
